items.caption: 主 in a modern reconstruction of the Shuowen seal-script style. 主 is analyzed as the phonetic component in 住.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 主 on a plain white background.
items.selection_reason: The pictured form matches the sourced identification of 主 and helps illustrate the proposed sound component. It is a modern redraw, not an artifact or an early form of 住.

limitations.text: No verified historical glyph of 住 is shown here. The selected image depicts 主 in a modern redraw, and the graphic history of 住 remains undocumented in the cited evidence.
